interpretation.directProvidedProperties: m_mapAbilityProperties rows with m_eProvidedPropertyType are the strongest resource-defined direct stat substrate, but exact composition/stacking semantics remain to be validated before use as effective PlayerState(t).
interpretation.nonDirectModifierTokens: Record-wide MODIFIER_VALUE_* tokens not represented by direct provided properties are preserved as conditional/passive/active/proc/aura/internal candidates and are not assumed continuously active.
interpretation.weaponState: Weapon-relevant tokens and fields identify items that may alter ammo, fire rate, reload, projectile/bullet behavior, range, spread, shot timing or weapon damage. Runtime applicability and exact formulas remain unresolved.
interpretation.ownership: This artifact contains no replay item ownership. A later replay stage must establish which player possessed which item at each time.
interpretation.expressions: String/expression property values are preserved verbatim instead of coerced into numeric values.
